description: This file defines the POSClosingEntry class and related functions for handling POS closing entries, including validation, reconciliation, and creation from opening entries in an ERP system.

classes.name: POSClosingEntry
classes.description: A class representing a POS closing entry, handling validation, submission, cancellation, and related operations.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the associated POS opening entry and POS invoices.

methods.name: validate_pos_invoices
methods.description: Checks the validity of POS invoices related to the closing entry.

methods.name: get_payment_reconciliation_details
methods.description: Returns payment reconciliation details rendered in a template.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Handles actions to perform when the closing entry is submitted.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Handles actions to perform when the closing entry is canceled.

methods.name: retry
methods.description: Retries the consolidation of POS invoices.

methods.name: update_opening_entry
methods.description: Updates the related POS opening entry's status.
